title: Flat and nested invocations do not share credential, deny, and cancellation boundaries
wanted_capability: One explicit per-invocation execution context carrying environment policy, authorization, cancellation and mutation completion ownership
missing_primitive: One explicit per-invocation execution context carrying environment policy, authorization, cancellation and mutation completion ownership
fallback_used: Isolated synthetic probes and explicit raw tool use; no shared service changes during audit.
notes: Synthetic full harness probe: flat shell_run omits AUDIT_CANARY; nested tools.shell_run exposes it under identical daemon-worker scrub settings. build.gate still executes when shell_* denied. See comprehensive audit.
resolution_note: Authority c0c41ac0 and cancellation cdf5aaaf are landed in beta. ToolCx carries child environment policy and cancellation, wrappers declare required capabilities and apply shared argument policy, and owned invocations retain mutation exclusion through actual completion. Eight authority probes and six cancellation probes remain green after shell output ce6284a6. Evidence: design/bro-harness/model-facing-tools-repair-plan.md and model-facing-audit invocation/cancellation repair receipts.
